questions.question: ABCD is cyclic quadrilateral. Sides AB and DC, when produced, meet at E, and sides BC and AD, when produced, meet at F. If ∠BFA = 60° and ∠AED = 30°, then the measure of ∠ABC is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cyclic quadrilateral** ABCD where sides AB, DC meet at E and BC, AD meet at F:

∠ABC = [180° + ∠AED − ∠BFA] ÷ 2

∠ABC = [180° + 30° − 60°] ÷ 2

∠ABC = 150° ÷ 2 = 75°

**∴ The correct answer is 75°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ∠BFA = 60°, ∠AED = 30°

**Formula Used:** Sum of opposite angles in a **cyclic quadrilateral** is 180°. Sum of angles in a **triangle** is 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e35b0d15985bcbec0af98edd903ebfd58895b247384bd9ab24fcbfd0340491e.png] 

Let ∠ABC = x and ∠BCD = y.

⇒ In ΔEBC, ∠E + ∠EBC + ∠ECB = 180°

⇒ 30° + (180° − x) + (180° − y) = 180°

⇒ x + y = 210° ... (1)

⇒ In cyclic quad ABCD, ∠ADC = 180° − x.

⇒ In ΔFDC, ∠F + ∠FCD + ∠FDC = 180°

⇒ 60° + (180° − y) + (180° − (180° − x)) = 180°

⇒ 60° + 180° − y + x = 180°

⇒ y − x = 60° ... (2)

⇒ Adding equations (1) and (2): 2y = 270° ⇒ y = 135°

⇒ Subtracting equation (2) from (1): 2x = 150° ⇒ x = 75°

**∴ The correct answer is 75°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

The sum of opposite angles is 180°. The exterior angle at any vertex is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180°.

Intersecting Chords Theorem

If two chords intersect inside a circle, the product of the segments of one chord equals the product of the segments of the other (PA × PB = PC × PD).</p
